name: mail-triage
description: Triage an incoming email: its kind, how much attention it needs, and whether it looks like phishing. All messages are synthetic. Baseline rules were written against the dev split only.

category.instructions: What kind of email is this?

criteria.personal: From a friend or family member about their own life or plans
criteria.billing: A bill, invoice, payment confirmation or subscription charge
criteria.work: About a job, a project, a meeting or a colleague's request
criteria.promo: Marketing, a sale, a newsletter or an unsolicited offer
criteria.security: About an account's sign-in, password, verification or suspicious activity

action.instructions: How much attention does this email need?
criteria: Read later: useful but nothing is due

phishing.instructions: This email looks like a phishing or scam attempt

criteria.true: Urgent threats, odd sender or links, requests for credentials or payment details
criteria.false: It reads as a genuine message
